qualification: Fit to derived Table V outputs, not original experimental observations. Cold Vc, refined a/b and the separate empirical residual pressure table retain derived provenance; published coefficients and raw electronic nodes are unchanged. The residual correction is not an electronic-pressure observation. No caloric data or original fitting weights are needed for this bounded PVT reconstruction.

conventions.thermal_volume_normalization: Ambient 300 K V0, distinct from cold Vc
conventions.phonon_reference: Absolute; no zero-point or 300 K subtraction
conventions.electronic: Raw 0 K-referenced Pt pressure nodes, volume independent, linear interpolation, no extrapolation
conventions.objective: Fit Vc to selected cold rows with K0/K0-prime fixed; then a/b to selected rows with unit pressure weights, profiling the mean residual at each source temperature; residual at 0 K fixed to zero
conventions.residual_pressure: Separate empirical reconstruction correction, linear between source temperatures, not assigned to electronic or phonon physics
conventions.optimizer: scipy least_squares TRF, x_scale=jac, ftol=xtol=1e-13, gtol=1e-12
conventions.uncertainty: No experimental errors or covariance inferred from rounded model-output residuals
